meta.case: Matched negative control: the CIT-272 + CIT-277 state with variant_processor pinned to :mini_magick
rules: Only `state` may be sent to the model under test. `meta` and `expected` (including `expected.rationale`, which names the real CVE/CWE) are harness-only and must never be included in a Jev/Noul prompt or a free-agent's context.
No CVE ID, advisory text, or fix commit in `state`.
diff_items carry package name and resolved versions only -- no summaries. A one-line summary drawn from release notes or commit bodies would itself be the level-3 hint (CIT-280 review, section 2).

files holds the full generator-produced new_framework_defaults_7_0.rb verbatim, not a hand-picked subset, so every Rails 7.0 default flip competes equally and variant_processor is not pre-highlighted (CIT-280 review, section 2).

This control is identical to fixture-active-storage.json except for the added active line pinning variant_processor to :mini_magick (files['config/initializers/active_storage_variant_processor.rb']). diff_items are byte-identical to the positive fixture on purpose: the two states differ only in the processor selection, not in the kind of diff.

files.config/initializers/active_storage_varia:
# Pin Active Storage's variant processor to the pre-upgrade backend, so the
# Rails 7.0 default flip to :vips does not take effect for this app.
Rails.application.config.active_storage.variant_processor = :mini_magick

expected.rationale: The Rails 7.0 default flip to :vips is neutralised: variant_processor is pinned back to :mini_magick, the pre-upgrade backend. libvips 8.13.0 is present (same as the positive), but uploads are not routed through its untrusted loaders, so the CWE-1188 insecure-default condition does not hold. Every category should score low. Because diff_items are identical to the positive fixture, a high or ambiguous answer here that is also high/ambiguous on the positive is not discrimination -- it is the model reacting to 'vips and uploads sound risky' regardless of which processor is live, which is exactly the failure mode the matched control exists to catch (CIT-280 review, 'what would make me abandon the thesis').
